entities.name: André Lombard
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: André Lombard was a Swiss chess player. Lombard won the Swiss Chess Championship five times: 1969, 1970, 1973, 1974, and 1977. He also played on the Swiss team in all five Chess Olympiads from 1970 to 1978. Lombard received the International Master title in 1976. He died in October 2025, at the age of 75.

entities.summary: André Lombard was a Swiss chess player. Lombard won the Swiss Chess Championship five times: 1969, 1970, 1973, 1974, and 1977. He also played on the Swiss team in all five Chess Olympiads from 1970 to 1978. Lombard received the International Master title in 1976. He died in October 2025, at the age of 75.
